item.title: Nephilim! 🎵⚔️
item.description:
Nephilim! 🎵⚔️

While the team is hard at work on the next patch - more on that very soon - the Crimson Moon Original Soundtrack is now available to stream!

Take the sounds of Gildenarch with you, featuring music from our incredibly talented audio team alongside boss tracks featuring HEALTH, Ricky Armellino, Misha Mansoor and Jared Dines 🩸

🎧 Listen now on Spotify, Apple Music & YouTube Music.

And as always, thank you for your patience and feedback while we continue working on improvements to the game. ⚔️
